scope: Reconciliation manifest for every current minigame research package. It inventories factual research and proposed normalization only. It does not rank activities, select a route, grant player outcomes, modify production data, or resolve disputed mechanics.

packages.domain: team combat minigame and Void shop

covered_activity_families: team and PvP activities: Barbarian Assault, Fishing Trawler, Pest Control, and Last Man Standing
reactive encounters: Guardians of the Rift, Tempoross, Wintertodt, Nightmare Zone, and Hallowed Sepulchre
shop-backed skilling: Giants' Foundry, Mage Training Arena, Mahogany Homes, Motherlode Mine, and Tithe Farm
location-specific utility and collection-log paths: Pyramid Plunder, Rogues' Den, and Shades of Mort'ton
cross-system coverage: currencies, fixed shop prices, and reward ownership boundaries
transport alternatives and durable utility unlocks
team, PvP, encounter, charge, and attention-state observations
coverage_inventory.scope_boundary: This is an inventory of the 17 on-disk packages, not a claim that every OSRS minigame has a research package. Activities without a current package are intentionally outside this manifest.

package_source_catalog_duplicates.rule: Each duplicate ID has one URL and one checked date across its packages. Register once centrally and retain package-local provenance.

proposed_outside_contract.handling: Represent Warmth as an observed encounter state, not a structural output edge.
Collection-log state is player-confirmed; do not create a derived graph edge from outfit ownership.

canonicalization_contract.activity_ids: Use activity:<kebab-case-activity>. Existing production IDs take precedence. Normalize the package-only activity:Giants_Foundry alias to existing activity:giants-foundry; do not create a second Foundry node.
canonicalization_contract.currency_ids: Use currency:<domain>:<kebab-case-name>, except retain an established production ID exactly when one exists. Coins are always currency:coins with an activity-specific ledger or condition, never a new activity coin currency.
canonicalization_contract.resource_ids: Use resource:<domain>:<name> for consumed inputs and stackable materials, not currency. Use item:<name> for transferable tokens, keys, pages, kits, shards, and one-off consumables.
canonicalization_contract.reward_ids: Use item:<name> for owned equipment, unlock:<name> for permanent account changes, capability:<domain>:<effect> for an ongoing benefit, and collection-log:<activity> only for an explicitly observed set of entries.
canonicalization_contract.observation_ids: Use observation:<activity>:<subject> for report shapes. Store live round, team, local inventory, charge, death, travel, and result state as optional observations. A missing field means unknown, never false or zero.
canonicalization_contract.state_and_charge_ids: Use state:<activity>:<subject> for live or account state and charge:<item> for finite charges. A charge cap, daily reset, or cooldown is a factual constraint; it does not create a free repeatable transition.

edge_semantics.meaning: a sourced static gate, selected observed input, or confirmed prerequisite; it never proves arrival, readiness, or success
a confirmed deterministic quest, purchase, or milestone enables a durable fact or capability
only a fixed result after a player-confirmed event and complete observed inputs; it cannot represent probability, predicted XP, inferred points, or unobserved team success
an RNG roll, variable container, random encounter result, or external team result can yield the target; it never awards the target
another sourced path satisfies the same requirement; it does not imply the alternative is held, preferred, or ready
a documented modifier or convenience affects a future observed activity; it produces neither a result nor a recommendation
for live team, encounter, travel, death, charge, crop, timer, and local-inventory state. Do not emit a graph edge until the production graph has an explicit observed-event contract.

safe_now: source provenance, current page dates, package-local source aliases, static access requirements, fixed shop stock, fixed costs, item use gates, and documented capacity limits
bounded factual corrections listed below, provided each change retains its checked package source IDs
deterministic purchase specifications that require an observed balance, chosen item, any prerequisite ownership state, and a player-confirmed transaction
RNG, variable-container, team, and encounter availability as makes_obtainable or observation-only facts rather than executable outcomes

recent_corrections_to_preserve.correction: The 2026 update gives deterministic shop paths for Abyssal needle at 750 pearls and Abyssal lantern at 1,500 pearls. Retain their independent RNG search paths and the permanent Guardian's Eye change.

The 2024 rework uses Warmth rather than Hitpoints and stores qualifying rewards as Reward Cart rolls rather than one Supply Crate per game. Low-Hitpoints rush logic is stale strategy, not current mechanics.

The current 0-255 contribution meter does not decay. Reward eligibility needs 50 contribution; full contribution increases fish relative to the 50-point baseline. Do not restore the old decaying-meter model.
The point cap is 16,000, not 1,000. Preserve current free shop can refills, current shop stock, Auto-weed reactivation, and 80-percent outfit resale without inferring crop outcomes.
Falador Hard does not grant a 10 percent pay-dirt XP modifier. The higher-level ore benefit is Elite-only; retain the already corrected shared fact and do not reintroduce the stale claim.
The checked current shop does not contain the proposed reusable Scroll of imbuing or blighted surge sacks. Proposals and historic reward-removal material are not available stock.

blockers_and_nonautomatic_boundaries.detail: Package catalogs are internally valid, but package-local IDs and current-page aliases must be registered or aliased in research/sources.json before production records cite them. The six repeated package IDs are consistent and should be centralized once.
Wintertodt proposes uses and contributes_to, which are outside the minigame package contract. Convert them to observation-only boundaries; do not silently widen the graph relationship vocabulary.
The package records current -10 quality per damage event while older shared wording uses -5 per mistake. Resolve the term and authority before any quality calculation or action validation.

Barbarian Assault, Fishing Trawler, Pest Control, Last Man Standing, Guardians of the Rift, Tempoross, Wintertodt, Nightmare Zone, and Hallowed Sepulchre require observed teams, queues, start state, success, point deltas, local supplies, damage, survival, and rewards.

Reward pools, carts, searches, crates, gambles, chests, coffins, pets, uniques, clue items, and collection-log rows remain explicit observed results. Use makes_obtainable for the source activity only.

Reward Cart rolls, Pharaoh's sceptre charges, Ring of endurance charges, Hallowed tokens/shards, Tithe sessions, daily LMS forfeits, diary modifiers, and temporary activity supplies need observed balances and reset/charge semantics. Caps are not balances and do not regenerate or spend themselves.

Keep start-only Fishing Trawler credit, Barbarian Assault wave credit, Pest Control diary credit, Rogues' Den lobby-safe credit, Pyramid Plunder task state, Shades tasks, and NMZ-origin Salve provenance separate from generic activity success or equivalent items.
Verify the exact Western diary credit condition and encode Elite Void per-piece/full-set effects without collapsing the current Prayer, Magic, and Ranged wording into one ambiguous claim.

Guardian mummy entrance state, chest/sarcophagus success, hazards, rates, and sceptre results are live or RNG state. Preserve current 3/10/25/50/100 charge capacities and do not automate historic rotation claims.
End-safe reward-rate claims conflict across sources, and the Falador Hard lobby wall-safe event is not interchangeable with an end-maze safe. Do not encode a rate or generic safe completion.
Temple repair is shared while sanctity/resources are per-player. Pyre-log compatibility beyond the source-backed table must not be inferred from newer Sailing-era log types.

AFK labels, rates, expected runs, target unlocks, reward order, world choice, team composition, low-supply claims, collection-log stops, and route timing remain strategy candidates after account observations, not production facts or actions.

unsafe_transition_catalog: Selecting an activity must not create XP, points, coins, contribution, permits, honour, Pizazz, Reputation, cart rolls, loot, a crop, a quest state, a diary task, an arrival, or an account-owned item.
A published drop rate, a missing collection-log entry, a reward-table eligibility condition, or a point cap must not create the reward or calculate an expected completion count.
A transport alternative, warm item, optional tool, diary bonus, purchased capability, or supplied LMS loadout must not certify combat readiness, survival, a successful round, or player location.
A shop price permits a deterministic selected transaction only after observed balance, prerequisite ownership, and confirmation; it cannot manufacture the currency that pays it.
A daily, cooldown, charge, timer, session, team, or world state cannot be advanced from elapsed time or plan intent. It is reported or remains unknown.

integration_waves.safe_scope: Register package sources and aliases, codify package count/ID/source validation, and preserve the research-only boundary.
integration_waves.must_not_do: Do not create production facts, actions, graph nodes, or account-state fields in this wave.

integration_waves.safe_scope: Reconcile source-backed current mechanics, capacities, reward-shop catalogs, and stale factual wording only. Preserve observed-result boundaries.
integration_waves.must_not_do: Do not calculate points, rewards, XP, expected runs, or player readiness.
expected_tests: focused regression checks for GOTR purchases, Wintertodt Reward Cart, Trawler meter, Tithe cap/shop, Falador/MLM, and LMS current stock

integration_waves.safe_scope: Add only fixed entry facts, selected deterministic shop specifications, and durable utility descriptions with explicit observed-balance and confirmed-transaction conditions.
integration_waves.must_not_do: Do not encode team availability, combat success, NPC contract selection, supplied loadouts, or activity output formulas as transitions.
expected_tests: no duplicate existing Rune pouch, MTA, Foundry, or POH concepts

integration_waves.safe_scope: Introduce optional, report-only activity observations for balances, purchases, live sessions, teams, encounter results, charges, local supplies, and collection-log rows. Validate supplied values without filling absent fields.
integration_waves.must_not_do: Do not infer successful activities or roll rewards from levels, elapsed time, current facts, or strategy candidates.
expected_tests: no output generated from plan intent

integration_waves.safe_scope: Add access, static reward-shop, current capacity, and explicit RNG/live-state facts after source and diary aliases are reconciled.
integration_waves.must_not_do: Do not resolve the Foundry conflict, Rogue rate gap, Pyramid world state, Pest Control diary ambiguity, or Shades state from inference.

input_packages: all packages with a resolved W1-W4 dependency
integration_waves.safe_scope: Amend existing actions first, then add only confirmed-transaction and explicit-report actions. Insert canonical nodes and edges using the contract above.
integration_waves.must_not_do: Do not add an autonomous round, reward search, team, crop, combat, or RNG simulator. Keep all unresolved packages blocked rather than partially executable.

wave_execution_rule: Waves are disjoint by package ownership and intended fact domain. Central registries, actions, and graph files are serial integration surfaces: one integrator edits them after the preceding wave is green; no two waves write them concurrently.
deferred_decisions: strategy scores, route order, stop conditions, AFK recommendations, and account-specific opportunity cost
